title: A supplied-system lifecycle, not a kernel-only claim
question: What does the existing execution → response → observation → inference path actually cost?

source.basis: Transcribed from an inspected repository summary; not a new run.

metric.timing_scope: reported finite lifecycle including setup share, output/response downloads and GH work
metric.uncertainty: min–max of five raw rows per case/regime; not a confidence interval

environment.precision: Selected direct-map/JVP path; FP16 response not supported by this benchmark

claim: Five supplied-system cases completed forward/JVP analytic checks and observation/inference. These lifecycle regimes are not an algorithm-versus-baseline speedup comparison.
limitations: The retained report says five raw measurements per regime, but the referenced CSV and lease receipt are absent from this checkout; the reported raw SHA-256 cannot be verified here.
The temporary result JSON named by the report is absent. Project Control has no matching CUDA evidence for the report ID.
The preparation record includes a source-file identity hash whose referent is unspecified; it was not independently authenticated.
Five raw measurements per regime would be min–max ranges, not confidence intervals; no ranges are published without raw rows.
One fifth of setup and teardown is assigned to each resident reuse. Full per-use downloads remain, and activity labels describe input-map changes rather than compact active execution.
Widths, operations and candidate counts differ between rows; these are not competing implementations and support no speedup comparison.
reproduce: Resolve the current benchmark driver and source-specific command from the original record; run under the existing assigned resources only if a refresh is justified.

selection.rationale: Omitted from public display. The report identifies a historical source commit, and the benchmark source at that commit is available, but its raw CSV and lease receipt under the private Todo runtime are absent, as is the temporary result JSON. The reported raw SHA-256 and hardware lease therefore cannot be authenticated in this checkout. The preparation record also contains an unbound source-file identity. Preserve this as an internal recorded summary only; do not plot or repeat its numbers publicly.

figure_context: V100-SXM2-16GB · five samples per scenario · full forward/response lifecycle
